style: Read this in a clear, upbeat, professional product-demo voice, at a steady pace:

lines.text: Kaizen Agent does not guess. When the agents need proof, the Root Cause agent pauses the incident and asks for field evidence.
The request lands on the technician's phone, with exactly what the AI needs to see: a close-up of insert T07.
The technician picks the photo from the evidence library, and checks the shot before saving it.
The evidence goes straight back to the agents, and the job shows the AI re-checking.
Gemini reads the photo, confirms severe chipping on the insert, and confidence rises from ninety to ninety-eight percent. Only then does the repair begin.
Every decision is backed by product evidence. Kaizen Agent, built on Google Cloud.
